description: See what model calls cost your workspace over a period (this month so far by default): totals, how much ran on your own provider key and how much on the platform's, and a daily series. Pass start_date and end_date to choose the period. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

end_date.description: The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

start_date.description: The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

name: get_llm_usage
